currentCard.prompt: К какой системе органов относится желудок?

answers.note: В желудке пища перемешивается с желудочным соком, а белки начинают расщепляться под действием соляной кислоты и пепсина.
Дыхательная система проводит воздух и обеспечивает газообмен.
Нервная система принимает, обрабатывает и передаёт сигналы.
Мочевыделительная система включает почки, мочеточники, мочевой пузырь и мочеиспускательный канал.

currentCard.explanation: Желудок относится к пищеварительной системе. В нём пища перемешивается с желудочным соком и начинает активно перевариваться.

literal.prompt: К какой системе органов относится желудок?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Stomach is a segment of the alimentary canal linking esophagus and duodenum and carrying out digestion(23.4L31–36,100), uniquely digestive system. Respiratory conduction/exchange(22.1L30–36), nervous sensory/motor transmission(13.4L96,106–107) and urinary tract(NIDDKL167–168) are distinct systems. Neural innervation/enteric structures within digestive organs(13.4L31–32) do not make the whole stomach a nervous-system organ. Four answers are grammatical comparable organ-system categories.

sourcesLocators.claimGround: Stomach is alimentary-canal expansion connecting esophagus/duodenum; mixes food with digestive juices, mechanically digests and initiates protein breakdown via HCl and pepsin. L81–82 absent and partialL80 are not used.
Conducting zone routes air; respiratory zone exchanges gases; respiratory organs provide O₂ and remove CO₂.
Brain/spinal cord central nervous organs integrate sensory/motor pathways and perform neural processing; brain hemispheres communicate via corpus callosum. Only returnedL0–164/214 exists.

PNS has sensory fibers sending action potentials into CNS and motor fibers transmitting commands to peripheral targets; enteric neural structures are features incorporated into digestive organs, not reclassification of whole stomach as nervous system.

sourcesLocators.locator: NIDDK Your Kidneys & How They Work L156–175,especiallyL167–168
sourcesLocators.claimGround: Kidneys make urine; ureters conduct it to bladder; bladder stores it. Urinary-tract figure descriptionL168 explicitly lists kidneys, ureters, bladder and urethra.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: First sentence classifies alimentary-canal organ as digestive(23.4L31–36); second describes food mixed with gastric juice and digestion underway(L35–36,44,102,110). “Начинает активно перевариваться” does not assert all digestion first begins here or deny mouth digestion; sourceL31,34,36 preserves that context. Two sentences directly name пищеварительная система.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Food mixed with gastric juice is explicitL35,102. Protein breakdown beginning through HCl and pepsin is explicitL110; L50–52 distinguishes acid activation/denaturation from enzymatic proteolysis. absoluteLevel.ground: Stomach belongs to digestive system is broad adult school/common knowledge; four real familiar organ systems are comparable choices. Solving does not require HCl/pepsin chemistry or neuroanatomy, which only support post-answer educational notes.
